data.notes: It hits all three must-catches: it cuts the approval-rate claim despite the win, treats 'what do we lose' (PayPal, Venmo, saved cards) as messaging to answer, and uses 'sitter pay' and 'paid by Friday'. It also keeps the Braintree theory clearly framed as Priya's guess. The decider insight says 'not finance' instead of adding the one line on when sitters get paid that the CFO asked about, and it never notes the incumbent's account-manager churn.
